title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:ROTOR:DISC HUB (341,364 affected)
summary: SEVERE CORROSION DUE TO ROAD SALT AT THE JOINT OF THE STAMPED STEEL CENTER SECTION AND THE CAST OUTER SECTION CAN CAUSE THE SECTIONS TO SEPARATE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY (1,131,000 affected)
summary: A MALFUNCTIONING CHECK VALVE WITHIN THE FUEL PUMP ASSEMBLY CAUSES A PORTION OF THE UNUSED FUEL FROM ONE TANK TO BE RETURNED TO THE SECOND TANK. WHEN THIS OCCURS, THE CAPACITY OF THE SECOND TANK CAN BE EXCEEDED, CAUSING FUEL SPILLAGE.

title: GRUMMAN CORP.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (100 affected)
summary: THE BATTERY CABLES WERE LOCATED EITHER ADJACENT TO OR TOUCHING THE TURBOCHARGER OF THE ENGINE. HIGH TEMPERATURES OF THE TURBOCHARGER CAN MELT THE CABLE INSULATION, CAUSING AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC (76,000 affected)
summary: AN ENGINE PREHEATING TUBE MAY NOT BE PROPERLY SUPPORTED DUE TO A MISSING SUPPORT BRACKET, CAUSING THE PREHEATING TUBE TO CHAFE AGAINST THE RIGHT FRONT METAL BRAKE LINE. THIS CAN DAMAGE THE HYDRAULIC LINE, CAUSING BRAKE FLUID LEAKAGE AND DIMINISHED BRAKING IN ONE BRAKE CIRCUIT.

title: DANA CORPORATION: STEERING:LINKAGES (83 affected)
summary: CERTAIN S9000 FRONT DRIVE AXLE ASSEMBLIES MAY CONTAIN A TIE-ROD WHICH MAY FRACTURE AT THE ADJUSTABLE SLEEVE DUE TO FATIGUE.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: STRUCTURE:BODY ROOF:CONVERTIBLE TOP (126 affected)
summary: THE LATCH HOOK ON THE CONVERTIBLE TOP CAN CRACK, DEVELOPING INTO A BREAK OF THE LATCH HOOK, IMPAIRING ITS FUNCTION.

title: General Motors, LLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:ALTERNATOR:GENERATOR (352,833 affected)
summary: THE GENERATOR ELECTRICAL WIRING IS NOT PROTECTED AGAINST EXCESSIVE CURRENT FLOW WHICH MAY BE CAUSED BY AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT IN THE GENERATOR.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS (2,000 affected)
summary: THE FRONT DOOR CONTROL LATCH SYSTEM FAILS DUE TO BREAKAGE OF THE LATCH PIN.

title: DORSEY CORPORATION: BRAKES:AIR:DRUM AND SHOE SYSTEMS:ADJUSTERS:SLACK (50 affected)
summary: IMPROPER INSTALLATION OF EATON AUTOMATIC SLACK ADJUSTER ON EATON AXLES EQUIPPED WITH AIR OPERATED S-CAM BRAKES. THE SLACK ADJUSTER "FIXED ANCHOR BRACKET",  WHICH TRIGGERS THE AUTOMATIC BRAKE ADJUSTMENT, WAS IMPROPERLY LOCATED. THE IMPROPERLY LOCATED ANCHOR BRACKET CAN DAMAGE THE AUTOMATIC SLACK ADJUSTER CONTROL ARM AND CAUSE THE SLACK ADJUSTER TO FAIL TO PERFORM THE MECHANICAL ADJUSTMENT FUNCTION FOR WHICH IT WAS DESIGNED.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (772 affected)
summary: THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE CONNECTOR MAY BE ATTACHED TO THE POSITIVE TERMINAL EXTENSION AT AN ANGLE WHICH MAY CAUSE CONTACT BETWEEN THE CONNECTOR AND THE BATTERY SUPPORT CAUSING AN ELECTRICAL SHORT.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: STRUCTURE:BUMPER ASSEMBLY (715 affected)
summary: THE SCREWS ISSUED IN A KIT TO MOUNT THE FENDER AND AN ACCESSORY FRONT BUMPER ONTO THE MOTORCYCLES CAN BREAK, CAUSING THE FENDER AND BUMPER TO LOOSEN AND POSSIBLY CONTACT THE FRONT TIRE.

title: HWH CORPORATION: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:TRUCK (1,190 affected)
summary: THE FRONT LEFT JACK ON THESE MOTORHOMES MAY BE IMPROPERLY INSTALLED.

title: SPECTRE INDUSTRIES, INC.: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS (20,000 affected)
summary: UNDER CERTAIN HEAT CONDITIONS, THE CLEAR PLASTIC BARREL OF THE FILTER CAN DEFORM SLIGHTLY AND ALLOW GASOLINE TO LEAK.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (11,000 affected)
summary: THE ENGINE COOLING FAN BLADES MAY BREAK DUE TO INADEQUATE BLADE STRENGTH AROUND THE RIVETS THAT ATTACH THE BLADES TO THE FAN SPIDER.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: EXHAUST SYSTEM (85 affected)
summary: THESE MOTORHOMES ARE SUSCEPTIBLE TO ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRES . THE CAUSE IS NOT LIMITED TO ONE COMPONENT OR SYSTEM.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: STEERING:POWER ASSIST (336 affected)
summary: POWER STEERING HOSE ASSEMBLIES WERE BUILT WITH INCORRECT END FITTINGS. THESE END FITTINGS WERE RATED AT 1250 PSI WORKING PRESSURE AND THE CORRECT END FITTINGS ARE RATED AT 2000 PSI.

title: FOUR WINDS CMPR. MFG. CO.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (1,024 affected)
summary: THESE TRAVEL TRAILERS HAVE TOO LIGHT A HITCH WEIGHT AS A PERCENTAGE OF TOTAL TRAILER WEIGHT.

title: Battle Motors, Inc.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:CALIPER (21 affected)
summary: THE BOLT WHICH ATTACHES THE REAR SUSPENSION TORQUE ROD TO THE AXLE BRACKET RESTRICTS THE MOVEMENT OF THE OUTSIDE BRAKE PAD, RESULTING IN ONLY THE INSIDE BRAKE PAD CONTACTING THE ROTOR.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER (1,026 affected)
summary: A GAP BETWEEN THE MASTER CYLINDER AND REMOTE BRAKE FLUID RESERVOIR ADAPTER IS CAUSED BY AN OUT-OF-SPECIFICATION CONDITION IN THE ADAPTER, RESULTING IN HYDRAULIC FLUID LOSS DURING BRAKE APPLICATION.
